name: vtable
meaning: 0x5742E8, one slot: D3DApp_ScalarDeletingDtor 0x406570. Written by D3DApp_Construct, D3DApp_ConstructUnfiltered and D3DApp_Destruct.

name: deviceReady
meaning: Set to 1 at the end of D3DApp_CreateDevice. Main_Loop's whole render/update block is gated on it via g_pPolyBatcher->pApp->deviceReady.

name: hWnd
meaning: (HWND) The render window. Passed to SetCooperativeLevel, the DirectInput SetCooperativeLevel calls and Main_Loop's GetDC/GetActiveWindow. Typed HWND__ * (the STRICT HWND) so the generator can declare it, as run3/app_main does.

name: hInstance
meaning: (HINSTANCE) Module handle, used only for DirectInput8Create. Typed HINSTANCE__ * (the STRICT HINSTANCE); read by DirectInput8Create in both constructors (0x4045cb) and CreateDevice (0x40546f).

name: clientRect
meaning: Destination rectangle of the present. Fullscreen: SetRect(0,0,modeW,modeH). Windowed: GetClientRect + two ClientToScreen calls, so it is in screen coordinates. Render_Present passes it as the Blt destination.

name: pDD
meaning: The DirectDraw7 object for the selected driver. Vtable uses seen: CreateClipper 0x10, CreateSurface 0x18, EnumDisplayModes 0x20, GetCaps 0x2C, GetDisplayMode 0x30, SetCooperativeLevel 0x50, SetDisplayMode 0x54, GetAvailableVidMem 0x5C.

name: pD3D
meaning: IDirect3D7 obtained by pDD->QueryInterface(IID_IDirect3D7 0x577728, &this->pD3D) in D3DApp_CreateDevice (0x405419-0x40543d). Released third by D3DApp_ReleaseInterfaces, zeroed by both constructors. Used elsewhere for CreateVertexBuffer.

name: pD3DDevice
meaning: IDirect3DDevice7 for the global g_pD3DApp (0x6d6568); vtable 0x50 SetRenderState, 0x94 SetTextureStageState, 0x2c SetTransform. Sibling +0x24 is the IDirect3D7 (see Draw_CreateScratchVertexBuffers 0x51e1f0).

name: devices
meaning: By-value array of enumerated render devices, stride 0x34B4. 20 slots ((0x41E3C-0x2C)/0x34B4).

name: deviceCount
meaning: Number of devices that survived the constructor's filtering.

name: deviceIndex
meaning: Currently selected device. Read by D3DApp_CreateDevice, D3DApp_GetModeString, Render_Present and HoleFX_CreateVertexBuffer.

name: pPrimary
meaning: Primary surface. Render_Present calls Flip (vtable 0x2C) on it in fullscreen or Blt (0x14) into clientRect in the windowed path.

name: pBackBuffer
meaning: Render target. Source of the present Blt, target of IDirect3D7::CreateDevice, source of GetSurfaceDesc in D3DApp_CreateTextureSurface, and the DC used by the debug FPS/clipboard helpers.

name: pZBuffer
meaning: Depth buffer, created from the format picked by D3DEnum_ZBufferFormatCallback and AddAttachedSurface'd to the back buffer.

name: pDInput
meaning: DirectInput8 object; all three device wrappers get their IDirectInputDevice8 from it.

name: joysticks
meaning: By-value array of attached game controllers, stride 0x60: char instanceName[0x50] (DIDEVICEINSTANCEA.tszInstanceName +0x28, not tszProductName +0x12c: DI_JoystickEnumCallback 0x4064fe) then GUID guidInstance at +0x50. 20 slots ((0x425D0-0x41E50)/0x60).

name: joystickCount
meaning: Number of attached controllers; D3DApp_HasJoystick returns it != 0.

name: joystickIndex
meaning: Controller chosen in the launcher; D3DApp_CreateJoystickDevice uses it.
